title: Black Knight Titan Guide + Titan's Wrath | Dragonwilds Dowdun Reach
author: SuperStooob
description:
The Black Knight Titan is finally here in Dowdun Reach and after defeating him multiple times, here's my complete guide covering every mechanic, Phase 1, Phase 2, preparation tips and Titan's Wrath.

In this video:

► Recommended setup
► Phase 1 mechanics
► Phase 2 mechanics
► Titan's Wrath review
► Dowdun Reach boss tips

00:00 Intro
00:43 Gear & Food/Items
01:42 Quick Tip 1
01:56 Phase 1 Mechanics
02:43 Phase 2 Mechanics
03:38 Fight Tips & Tricks
05:04 Titans Wrath Review

The Black Knight Titan is the final regional boss currently available in RuneScape Dragonwilds and rewards players with Broken Titan's Wrath, allowing the crafting of one of the strongest melee weapons currently available.
